sloka: दत्तमिष्टं हुतं चैव तप्तानि च तपांसि च ।वेदा: सत्यप्रतिष्ठानास्तस्मात् सत्यपरो भवेत् ॥ २.१०९.१४॥
transliteration: dattamiṣṭaṁ hutaṁ caiva taptāni ca tapāṁsi ca ।vedā: satyapratiṣṭhānāstasmāt satyaparo bhavet ॥ 2.109.14॥

translations.english: Charity, sacrifice, libations, mortifications, asceticism and the Vedas have truth as their foundation. Therefore, every one should be an adherent of truth.
translations.hindi: उन यशस्वी भरत को , दुःखी और विलाप करते हुए देख, धेयंबान्‌ श्रीराम समझा कर कहने .लगे
